★ Request
Wipe
Show Yukino Bijin
Costume: Gym Uniform (Bib number: 8, Shorts: Orange)
SFX: Murmurs

M-Mifuyu-chan! Even Dad...!
Umm... This person's just lookin' after my trainin' for now...

I won't lose, I won't lose...! 
I gotta win right here, right now...!

A surprise...?! What a fancy thing to do... You sure caught me off guard.
But... ahaha! All my jitters are gone now! Thank you so much!

Yukino-chan! We came to cheer ya on! Give 'em hell today!
Oh, it's been ages! My, look how big you've grown!
WOOOOOOOOOH!
J-J-Jajaja!!?

So many more folks found out about Yuki-chan and wanted to cheer her on.
Since everyone's watching, it's the perfect chance to show what she's really made of.
Nnnghhhh... What?!

You bet! Here I go! I'm not givin' this up――!!
...Haaaaahhhhh!!
Hehe... Ehehe! Look how stunned everyone is...!
A future...? What kind of future would that be?

I'm gonna win! Everyone back home, all my fans, and Trainer...
Please, watch over me, all of you...!

We're countin' on ya too, Trainer. This girl's the hope of our whole village.
Please take good care of her for a long time to come.

...! Yes, sir...! I promise
I'll become a truly stylish "city girl" for sure!

No way...! She actually won...!
She's like a completely different person... Wait, is that the real Yukino Bijin...?
――Yuki-chan! We made it!!
...No, it's all up to me, isn't it...!
Huh...?

Holy cow! I had no idea she could run like that.
What are they feeding regional Umamusume these days?!
Ooooohhhhh!!

E-Everyone?! Mom and Dad too! Why are you all here?!
Hawawa, what in the world is with that glittery banner――!!?

Yukino Bijin! There's no stopping Yukino Bijin!
What a sensational late burst of speeeeed!

Fufufu... Your trainer gave us a call, you see?
So the whole village came to cheer you on.

――The day of the Selection Race had finally arrived.
And I had secretly invited some special guests today...!

Yuki-chan's gonna win...! She's not just some "pretty face."
She's a gritty, gutsy Umamusume from Morioka! Everyone! Make some noise!
...! A-A craze is... an opportunity...

I bought a Yukino-chan plushie~! 
She already has official merch, she's seriously such an idol~!

She passed them...?! 
Whoa, whoa, the pack behind her is getting left in the dust...?!

J-Jaja!!? A-Are you sure...?
I mean, that's... a dream come true for me, but...!

...Um, Yuki-chan's Trainer.
Please keep taking good care of Yuki-chan!

Yuki-chan... I don't think you need to worry so much.
I mean, having a big craze around you isn't a bad thing...!

Well, making the top five is the best she can hope for. But for an idol Umamusume,
that's plenty. Just having her in the race hypes up the crowd.

Hype and luck are important! If people don't know who you are,
you can't even get started. ...A craze is your chance!

...! This is just a passing craze...
I don't deserve this kind of popularity...

Whoa, Yukino Bijin has settled into a great position!
Can she stay right on the leader's heels――?!
And the gates burst open...!

Eee! It's Yukino Bijin-chan!
She's so cute today too! We're rooting for you~~!

――And 9th favorite is this girl, Yukino Bijin.
High expectations for this lovely regional "pretty face" to give it her all!
Whoa! Yuki-chan, you're super popular! That's amazing!

(And here I was, mopin' and thinkin' it's "just hype"...
When gettin' noticed is somethin' I oughta be mighty grateful for...)

Congrats, Yuki-chan! You were truly, truly amazing...!
You gave me so much courage. I'm gonna give it my all in skating too!

I'm gonna be... a "city gurl"!!
No matter whaaaaaaat――!!

No change at the front! Yukino Bijin,
pulling away by a commanding three lengths to hit the GOOOOOAL!!!

Haa, haa...! Haaahhh~!
I-I did it! I won, y'all――!!

I wanna stand on that side too! Stand proud alongside those sparkly Umamusume...
Strong and cute――
